name: Random Game Picker
summary: Pick a random game from the existing EmulationStation library with filters and scraped artwork.

notes: First stable upstream release of the current feature set, following the owner's successful alpha.2 TSP retest. The exact firmware and full launch/return matrix were not supplied; MagicX and performance remain unverified, so Store review status remains experimental.

The picker reads effective ES system configuration, gamelists and the live ES catalogue; no game ROM directory or emulator command is hardcoded. Ports, collections, missing/hidden games and ambiguous launch paths are excluded.

The only network use is bounded HTTP to 127.0.0.1:1234. Play closes SDL, sends one exact raw-path POST to ES and exits. HTTP acceptance does not confirm play; there is no retry or nested configgen fallback.

The Store owns only its package directory and one Ports menu entry. Runtime settings and the per-session log remain under state and survive repair, update and uninstall. A nonstandard configured Ports root needs manual installation in that root instead.

Includes the TSP-tested A/B and X/Y correction: default KNULLI SDL bindings translate back to ES labels. The launcher honors the Ports Xbox-layout flag, which keeps the identity mapping. Both launcher and binary must update together; this report does not verify every external controller or MagicX.

AArch64 ELF inspection establishes a glibc 2.36 minimum. System SDL2, SDL2_image and SDL2_ttf are required. No firmware library is replaced. Persistent indexing, Surprise Mode and device performance evidence are not included.

evidence.note: Version-pinned stable ZIP: 1,088,560 compressed bytes, 2,820,305 regular-file bytes; SHA-256 ab7e8fb9da6702fca8befd1fff7df60f32fb0ac6a5ca6439181e0d86bd30a5e2. Exact size and digest reject replacement bytes even if GitHub permits release asset replacement.
MIT project license; archive includes notices for the font, static pugixml, JSON headers and libstdc++ runtime exception. SDL libraries remain system dependencies.

ELF64 AArch64, interpreter /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1; highest GLIBC symbol 2.36. NEEDED: libSDL2_image-2.0.so.0, libSDL2_ttf-2.0.so.0, libSDL2-2.0.so.0, libm.so.6, libc.so.6, ld-linux-aarch64.so.1. libstdc++, libgcc and pugixml are static.

Launcher sets package-local state and reads /var/run/ports_xbox_layout.flag without writing it. Source has no shell command construction, download or self-update. Settings JSON and last-run.log are the runtime writes. ES config, ROMs, art and saves are read-only to the picker; the launched emulator can make its normal writes.

Host contracts, SDL controller-event regression for all four actions in default KNULLI and Xbox modes, real SDL fixture at 1280x720 and 640x480, 100 rerolls per size, filters, PNG/JPEG preview, corrupt-art fallback, empty recent pool/reset, window teardown before exactly one fake-ES raw-path POST; cross-package ABI gate. Regression failed on alpha.1. This is not a physical-controller or emulator launch test.

2026-10-19: owner confirmed the corrected alpha.2 works on TSP and requested the first stable release. Firmware details and the full device matrix were not supplied. This owner report is not an independent public hardware-verification report.

install.warning: Stable upstream release; Store review remains experimental. Owner tested TSP; MagicX and the full launch/performance matrix remain unverified. Requires glibc 2.36+, SDL2/image/ttf and local ES API. Submit Play once; inspect state/last-run.log before retrying. Standard Ports location only. Settings/logs stay after uninstall.
